# Original comparison evaluation controls

These small Markdown files are independently authored from the title and first
prose sentence of `../formulas/formula_equations.pdf`. They intentionally omit
the rest of that original PDF. `manifest.json` pins byte hashes and explicit
title-count, order and operation expectations for retention, deletion,
duplication and movement. This material is original and uses the repository's
MIT license; no benchmark prose is included.

Run the development adapter as documented in
[`docs/COMPARISON_ADAPTER.md`](../../../docs/COMPARISON_ADAPTER.md). Do not update
expected facts merely to accommodate changed comparator output. Deliberate input
changes require reviewed facts and new SHA-256 hashes. `.gitattributes` preserves
LF Markdown bytes across Windows checkouts.
